gaps.lead: Selling the boat was a big mistake.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle expresses regret about a past action.

gaps.lead: Nobody else in the team runs as fast as Maya.
gaps.explanation: nobody runs faster = she is the fastest runner.

gaps.lead: You'll fail your exam if you don't revise.
gaps.explanation: unless + present simple = if you don't.

gaps.lead: I regret not studying harder at university.
gaps.explanation: 'I regret not doing' = 'I wish I had done' — wish + past perfect for past regrets.

gaps.lead: As I get older, I become less patient.
gaps.sentence: The older I get, ___ I become.
gaps.explanation: The older…, the more… — doubled comparatives for parallel change.

gaps.lead: Despite his serious injury, he finished the marathon.
